digest.component_or_area: rebar CLI argument parsing and comment storage
propositions: rebar comment accepts flag-like tokens (--body-file, --body) as positional body argument, storing the flag name itself rather than the intended content, and exits 0 silently
subsequent positional arguments after a flag-like token are discarded by args[:min_args] slice, compounding data loss and preventing recovery
no error or warning is raised when a body argument begins with dash, making the failure undetectable until content is read downstream
the same footgun exists across all positional-body commands (comment, create, edit, session-log, tag, untag, archive, set-verify-commands) and requires a uniform guard
body arguments beginning with dash must be rejected with non-zero exit unless explicitly escaped with -- prefix
